title: DR06 2-round AES / aes-2r-superbox-maximum-edp-dr2006-property

target.description: Two AES nonlinear layers reduced to four parallel 32-bit SB -> MC -> ARK(k32) -> SB superboxes by commuting/removing external linear layers. The reported maximum is for one active superbox and inactive others, not a product of four nontrivial maxima.

setting.key_relation: Probability is averaged over independent uniformly sampled round keys, not the standard master-key schedule.
setting.plaintext_model: Differential pair probabilities averaged over uniform inputs and intermediate superbox key; no attack queries.

time.note: Mathematical property, not an attack resource.

data.note: Mathematical property, not an attack resource.

memory.note: Mathematical property, not an attack resource.

preprocessing.note: Mathematical property, not an attack resource.

success.description: Probability in the statement is not an attack success or resource cost.

evidence.locator: Complete PDF pp.1–17 / printed78–94; Sections2–9 and AppendicesA–C; maximum PDF pp.13–14 / printed90–91 Section9.
evidence.interpretation: Full primary, result inventory, original maximum attribution and bounded forward checks complete. Twelve finite witnesses each have75 trails and EDP13.25×2^-32; this does not independently prove a global maximum. The source credits Keliher–Sui[4] for that proof.

limitations: The EDP averages over independent intermediate round keys; it is not a fixed standard-master-key probability.
Self-written enumeration confirms the twelve listed witnesses, not exhaustive maximization. Local stochastic-model discrepancies in separate properties do not change this endpoint.

property.statement: The maximum two-round AES-superbox EDP is 2^-30 + 74*2^-35 = 13.25*2^-32. Exactly twelve maximizing differentials form three fourfold-rotation classes; each has 75 trails with all five double S-box differentials on the same trail.
property.quantifier: Maximum over nonzero 32-bit input/output differences, EDP averaged over the uniformly distributed 32-bit intermediate superbox key. Other full-state superboxes can have zero input/output differences.
property.scope: Standard AES S-box and MixColumns; 32-bit superbox lifted through the external-linear equivalence, not a fixed-master-key differential guarantee.

parameters.name: maximum_edp
parameters.meaning: Expected differential probability, not a time/data exponent.

parameters.name: maximizing_differentials
parameters.meaning: Three difference shapes with four cyclic rotations, not twelve distinct attacks.

parameters.name: difference_shapes
parameters.meaning: Source Section 9 difference representatives; arithmetic is in GF(2^8).

validation.description: Section 9 explains the maximum previously established by Keliher–Sui [4], ePrint 2005/321; not a new DR06 maximum proof reproduction.
